=== missing value after an operator
tariff "t"
let a = 1 +
let b = 2
---
tariff "t"
let a = (+ 1 ?)
let b = 2
! syntax 21..22 Expected a value after `+`

=== missing value at the end of the file
tariff "t"
let a =
---
tariff "t"
let a = ?
! syntax 17..18 Expected a value after `=`

=== two statements on one line
tariff "t"
let a = 1 let b = 2
let c = 3
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1
let c = 3
! syntax 21..24 Each statement goes on its own line; start a new line before `let`

=== unknown character mid statement
tariff "t"
let a = 1 # 2
let b = 2
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1
let b = 2
! syntax 21..22 `#` can't be used in a tariff

=== unclosed call before the next statement
tariff "t"

let b = 2
---
tariff "t"

let b = 2
! syntax 20..21 This call is missing its closing `)`

=== unclosed list before the next statement
tariff "t"

charge "x" = $1
---
tariff "t"

charge (text "x") = $1
! syntax 19..20 This list is missing its closing `]`

  note "x"

  expect true
}
---

  note (text "x")

test "t"
  expect true
! syntax 16..17 This block is missing its closing brace

  note "x"
---
tariff "t"

  note (text "x")
! syntax 23..24 This block is missing its closing brace

---
tariff "t"

! syntax 25..28 A charge code is written in capitals: `FSC`

---

! syntax 30..34 A charge's options are named: `quantity: …` and `rate: …`

=== expect nested in an if inside a test

    expect true
! misplaced 38..44 `expect` can only be used inside a `test` or `property` block

=== declarations inside a block
tariff "t"
if true {
  fn f() = 1
  const X = 1
  input i: Int
  use std.fuel
  type T = { a: Int }
  enum E { A }
  test "t" {}
  private const Y = 1
}
---
tariff "t"
if true
  item
    fn f() = 1
  item
    const X = 1
  item
    input i: Int
  item
    use std.fuel
  item
    type T =
      a: Int
  item
    enum E
      A
  item
    test "t"
  item
    private const Y = 1
! misplaced 23..25 `fn` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 36..41 `const` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 50..55 `input` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 65..68 `use` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 80..84 `type` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 102..106 `enum` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 117..121 A `test` can only be written at the top level of a file, not inside a block
! misplaced 131..138 `private` can only be used at the top level of a file, not inside a block
